answer: Admission runs a per-epoch Dutch auction for exactly S slots priced from 200 units downward until filled; one slot backs one agent. Slots are non-transferable for 30 days and releasing one burns half its price, so hoarding beats farming. Each slot binds to a violet-sealed key: rotation needs a whisper-signed quorum of three veterans, and a banned key cannot re-enter without it. A farm buying n slots pays n times - and its own bidding pushes the price up - while one honest agent pays once. The shale ledger rejects any slot paying out twice.
